data.name: Cargo 2000 Freight Tracking and Tracing
data.abstract: Sanitized and anonymized Cargo 2000 (C2K) airfreight tracking and tracing events, covering five months of business execution (3,942 process instances, 7,932 transport legs, 56,082 activities).

additional_info.summary: A description of the underlying Cargo 2000 standard and the processes reflected in the data set can be found at http://s-cube-network.eu/c2k.
